why_ai: Dispatch is already algorithmic, but couriers still physically carry orders and robots cover little by 2031.
why_clarity: An order delivered on time is an exact, instantly checked outcome repeated millions of times.
why_digital: Orders are digital and app-booked, but the value is a physical handoff at a door.

why_ai: Dispatch is fully automated operations research; only the choice of objective needs people.
why_clarity: Assignment quality is measured instantly on throughput and delivery promises.
why_digital: Order and courier data in, assignments out, computed in real time.

why_ai: Net-earnings accounting joins instrumented data and is directly automatable.
why_clarity: Earnings per hour after costs is a precise calculation once inputs are joined.
why_digital: Earnings, time and mileage records are computed into reports.

why_ai: Wait time is already geofence-measured; paying and attributing it is a software and policy change.
why_clarity: Arrival-to-pickup minutes are measured exactly on every delivery.
why_digital: Geofence data is digital, though the wait itself happens at a physical counter.

why_ai: Offers are fully algorithmic; the contest is over policy, under some regulatory scrutiny.
why_clarity: Offers repeat endlessly, but what they should represent is contested.
why_digital: Computed offers are shown in an app with a countdown.

why_ai: Predicting engaged time and cost from instrumented inputs is a standard ML task.
why_clarity: Each prediction is checked against the realised delivery within the hour.
why_digital: Instrumented delivery data in, predictions out.

why_ai: Screening is automated end to end, though FCRA disputes and proportionality need accountable review.
why_clarity: Millions of identical checks run, but errors in county records surface only on dispute.
why_digital: Documents, selfies and records checked online with decisions in hours.

why_ai: No computation is needed; disclosure is a legal and regulatory decision by accountable leaders.
why_clarity: Pay components are known exactly when every offer is generated.
why_digital: Offer components already exist as data and display in an app.

why_ai: Shoppers must physically pick in aisles, though preference models will take over the substitution choice.
why_clarity: Substitutions repeat constantly, but shoppers guess and learn they were wrong only from ratings.
why_digital: Order history is digital, but picking happens in a store and groceries reach a door.

why_ai: Couriers physically carry orders across cities; robots and drones cover only a sliver by 2031.
why_clarity: Each delivery is a near-identical task with instant completion confirmation.
why_digital: Work is driving and handoffs, found and accepted through an app.

why_ai: Deciding whether someone keeps their income is consequential and deliberately kept with a human.
why_clarity: Policy-driven reviews repeat in queues, but whether a decision was right is rarely checked.
why_digital: Flags, evidence and decisions handled entirely in trust and safety tools.
